## 0. The 15:24Z dashboard scare — diagnosis

A dashboard sourced from `bd list -l flt --all` showed the campaign headline as
*"T1: freeze a theorem with exactly the Odlyzko_statement signature"* with **0/1 beads
closed**, which read as total loss of progress.

**Nothing was lost.** Three independent checks:

1. That headline is **verbatim the title of my own enrollment record `ENDGAME-T1`**
   (`cartography/enrollment/wave-3-and-endgame.json`). It is new work appearing, not old
   work vanishing.
2. The same dashboard's *"In flight now"* line still named `hub-r7qdn.7` and
   `hub-bv6v2.3` — **pre-existing beads, still present.**
3. Its `67 sorry/admit` figure **matches the live repo exactly** (`scripts/sorry_count.py`
   reports 67 naive at `1564364`), so the dashboard was reading live data correctly.

**Cause, and it was mine.** My 25 enrollment records were emitted with labels and metadata
but **no parent/epic link**. Created that way each becomes a *parentless root* bead, and a
dashboard that renders "campaign = newest root" will hoist a leaf packet into the headline
and count only that subtree — hence `0/1`. Fixed at 15:32Z: every record now carries
`parent: hub-oig35` and `campaign_root: hub-flqy3`. The parent id itself needs Fable's
confirmation, since I cannot read beads to verify `hub-oig35` is a real node rather than
just the prefix of `hub-oig35.N`.

**If any were already created as roots, re-parent rather than delete-and-recreate**, so ids
and receipts stay stable.

## 6. How to regenerate this file

Nothing here is remembered; it is all read live:

```bash
cd /home/agent/FLT && git fetch origin
python3 scripts/sorry_count.py --json      # baseline + orphan modules
python3 scripts/sorry_count.py --closure   # exits 1 while orphans exist
git log --oneline --since=today            # campaign commits
curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/futarchy-fi/FLT/pulls?state=all   # packet outcomes
```
